business_definition: Active employees on the last day of the month (permanent and contract).
formula: COUNT(DISTINCT employee_id) with hire_date <= month_end AND (exit_date IS NULL OR exit_date > month_end)
caveat: Excludes CEO if you compare departments only

business_definition: Employees whose hire_date falls in the month.
Employees whose exit_date falls in the month (resigned, terminated or contract ended).
Share of people who left in the month.
Leavers in the last 12 months divided by average headcount over the same months.
caveat: Use for headline reporting; monthly is too noisy
